type.label: Customer type
type.hint: Choose whether this customer is an individual person or a company.
type.lockedHint: The type can't be changed after the customer is created.
type.switchText: Fields of the other type will be cleared.

classification.statusHint: Current lifecycle status of this customer.
classification.statusNoPermissionHint: Only users with status permission can change it.
classification.tagsHint: Up to 50 tags. Type to search or create a new tag.
classification.tagsHintNoCreate: Up to 50 tags. Type to search.
classification.ratingHint: Rate the customer from 1 to 3 stars. Click the active star to clear.
classification.colorHint: Optional colour stripe shown on the customer card.

identity.title: Title
identity.titleHint: Pick from the list or type your own, up to 40 characters.

reach.mobileHint: Choose the country code, then type the number. At least one phone or an email is required.
reach.emailHint: Used for CRM emails. At least one phone or an email is required.

company.name: Company name
company.nameHint: Required. The name your team uses, up to 180 characters.
company.phoneHint: The main company number. Provide a company phone or email, or one on the primary contact.
company.emailHint: A shared company email address, not a person's email.
company.websiteHint: Starts with https:// or http://, up to 180 characters.

more.legalNameHint: The registered legal name. If left empty, the company name is used.
more.taxNumberHint: Up to 64 characters, as on official documents.
more.addressHint: Optional. Choose the country first, then the state and city.
more.previousAddressHint: Legacy address text saved before structured locations were used.
more.descriptionHint: General notes about this customer, up to 2000 characters.

errors.reachRequired: Enter at least one phone number or an email.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number with country code (e.g. +201001234567).
errors.phoneDuplicate: This number is already in the list.
errors.phonesMax: You can add up to 10 numbers.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
errors.websiteInvalid: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.
errors.contactsMax: You can add up to 20 contacts.
errors.cfUrl: Enter a link that starts with https:// or http://.
errors.cfPhone: Enter a valid phone number with country code.
